summary_en: FY7/26 final dividend raised to ¥20/share from ¥10/share previously announced (2025-09-12). No interim dividend. Upward revision follows earnings upgrade (2026-06-15) on improved operating profit, recurring profit, and net income to parent.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 15 July 2026, Towarise Corporation's board resolved to revise its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending July 2026. The final dividend per ordinary share has been increased to ¥20 from the previously forecasted ¥20 announced on 12 September 2025. No interim dividend is paid. The company stated that the revision follows an upward revision to full-year consolidated earnings guidance (announced 15 June 2026), reflecting improvements in operating profit, recurring profit, and net income attributable to parent shareholders. The company emphasises that shareholder profit distribution is a key management priority, and it pursues continuous and stable dividend payments while maintaining financial soundness and appropriate internal reserves. The company indicated it will continue promoting business development with a medium to long-term perspective to enhance group-wide enterprise value.
